name: Earthshape — each creature you control with power up to the earthbent land's gains hexproof and indestructible
notes: "Earthbend 3. Then each creature you control with power less than or equal to that land's power gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn." (2026-10-18) Earthbend is written out as the land becoming a 0/0 creature; the site places no counters, so the three +1/+1 counters are put on the Forest before the spell is added (Conor: an instant reads its snapshot). The land's power is its snapshot state as the spell leaves it (0/0 creature + 3 counters = 3), and the group is fixed from the snapshot: the Forest itself, Grizzly Bears and Hill Giant, not Craw Wurm (6) or the opponent's Llanowar Elves. Before the fix the comparison was a required subtype and nobody was reached.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

scryfallData.name: Craw Wurm
scryfallData.flavor_text: The most terrifying thing about the craw wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

scryfallData.name: Llanowar Elves
scryfallData.flavor_text: The elves of the Llanowar forest have defended it for generations. It is their sacred duty to keep outside influences from corrupting their ancestral home.
